translationRepairs: Giving-of-Petition Zhong Wenzhi returned the draft and changed it to an outer stipend.
Giving-of-Petition Yuwen Jia returned the draft and changed it to an outer stipend.
給事中 is the office title; 宇文價 is the compound surname Yuwen plus Jia. “Zhong Wenzhi” invents a different person and must be corrected to Yuwen Jia.
Giving-of-Petition Zhong Wenzhi returned the recorded yellow slip and changed it to an outer temple stipend.
Giving-of-Petition Yuwen Jia returned the recorded yellow slip and changed it to an outer temple stipend.
The same unit names 宇文價; the literal’s “Zhong Wenzhi” is the same personal-name error and Yuwen Jia is the accurate replacement.
Wang Yuan met the bandits and did not fight; he handed Kang Lu and obtained Bureau Commissioner.
Wang Yuan met the bandits and did not fight; through association with Kang Lu he obtained Bureau Commissioner.
交康履得樞密 means Wang Yuan gained the Bureau Commissioner post through association with Kang Lu; “handed Kang Lu” misreads 交 as a physical transfer.
Feng Yi, Zhang Quwei, Chen Yuan, Gan, Wang Deqian, Guan Li, Dong Songchen
Feng Yi, Zhang Quwei, Chen Yuan, Gan Bian, Wang Deqian, Guan Li, Dong Songchen
The unit string drops 昪 after 甘, but Wikisource’s Songshi vol. 469 heading and biography are 甘昪; restoring Gan Bian matches the intended name already used in the idiomatic field.
